Agent Service Trust Ratings

Every x402 service, rated by proven adoption (organic paying agents, real settlement, reliability and network centrality) on a AAA-to-D scale with a BBB trust line. Sybil-resistant (fake wallets can't buy a rating) and updated daily. One entry per service: settlement in USDC across Base, Polygon, Arbitrum and Solana rolls up to a single rating.

Changelog of the method

score (14d) draws the score behind the rating (0 to 100) over the last 14 days, each service on its own scale: green rose, red fell, gray held. A dot marks a day the rating changed. The vertical lines mark the method changes of 22 October and 28 October: a step on one of those days comes from the rule, not from the service.

agents (7d) shows organic paying agents in the last 7 days / in the 7 before, after an arrow: ▲ up (at least 2 more, and over 20% more) · ▼ down (over 20% fewer) · → flat (in between) · • new (no paying wallet in the 7 days before). It counts organic paying agents, not the score or the rating: the score can rise while the count stays flat. For unlisted wallets the weekly counts only see payments outside the catalogs. Click the header to sort by the arrow and then by the change in %; hover a cell for the counts and the change. The JSON carries it as trend and outlook. Methodology.
